method: The research container could not open the site itself (outbound fetches are refused), so the features come from web-search results of the site's own pages (listed in sources) and from how the product is publicly known to work; a feature not confirmed by a search result says so in its detail. Verse's side was read from this repository's source.

features.name: Forecast by city or ZIP
features.detail: point forecast for a 1.5 mile square

features.name: 7-day forecast
features.detail: text and icons, day and night

features.name: Hourly weather graph
features.detail: temperature, wind chill, heat index, dew point, wind, gusts, rain chance, rain and snow amounts, sky cover, humidity, out to 7 days
features.verse_evidence: stage weather card (skills/weather.js graph): temperature and chance of rain hour by hour to 7 days, each midnight named, the hour now marked; no wind, dew point or sky cover lines; /weather/ unchanged

features.name: Tabular forecast
features.verse_evidence: stage weather card: the next 8 hours from the hour now in one scrolling row, and the 7-day graph; no hour-by-hour table

features.name: Current conditions
features.detail: temperature, humidity, wind, barometer, dew point, visibility, wind chill, station and time
features.verse_evidence: stage weather card: temperature, feels like, wind, humidity, pressure (hPa or inHg), visibility and dew point now; no station name (Open-Meteo is a model, not a station)

features.name: Detailed text forecast
features.detail: the forecaster-written paragraph for each period

features.name: Air quality
features.verse_evidence: stage skill skills/air.js (US AQI); not on /weather/

features.name: Hurricanes, severe storms, fire, marine, aviation, rivers
Public API (api.weather.gov)
features.verse_evidence: Verse reads it; offers no API of its own
